canonical_authority_rule: A field may set canonical_for_parcel_facts=true only when expected_spatial_semantics is PARCEL, returned spatial_semantics is PARCEL, and parcel/geometry reference matches the confirmed geometry hash.

fields.definition: Ground elevation above the NAVD88 vertical datum at the queried point. Sourced from the USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second seamless DEM (~10m), with the USGS EPQS dynamic service as a coverage fallback.
Surface slope in degrees, computed from the USGS 3DEP DEM at the queried point. 0 = flat; 90 = vertical.
Slope aspect (compass bearing the slope faces) in degrees, 0=N, 90=E, 180=S, 270=W.
Slope aspect as a cardinal direction (N, NE, E, ..., NW) — the compass direction the slope faces.

USFS Land Change Monitoring System dominant land-cover class at the queried point, served from a bootstrapped ~120m block-mode CONUS grid (annual LCMS product). Life-form taxonomy — classes include Trees, Shrubs, Grass/Forb/Herb, cover mixes, Barren or Impervious, Water, Snow or Ice (no dedicated crop class). CONUS only.
fields.null_meaning: Outside the served LCMS CONUS grid footprint (AK/HI/PRUSVI/ocean) or on a non-processing/nodata cell, or the raster is not bootstrapped.

fields.definition: USFS LCMS land-use class (Agriculture / Developed / Forest / Other / Rangeland or Pasture / Non-Processing Area Mask), served from a bootstrapped ~120m block-mode CONUS grid. CONUS only.
fields.null_meaning: Outside the served LCMS CONUS grid footprint (AK/HI/PRUSVI/ocean) or on a non-processing/nodata cell, or the raster is not bootstrapped.

fields.definition: Most recent Sentinel-2 NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) at the queried cell, range -1 to +1. Higher = greener / more photosynthetic activity.
5-year change in NDVI at the queried cell. Negative values indicate vegetation loss; positive indicate growth or recovery.
Tree canopy cover percentage (0-100) at the point, sampled from the USFS/NLCD Tree Canopy Cover product served as a bootstrapped ~120m CONUS grid. CONUS only.
fields.null_meaning: Outside the served NLCD TCC CONUS grid footprint (AK/HI/PRUSVI/ocean) or on a nodata/non-processing cell, or the raster is not bootstrapped.

fields.definition: True if the queried point intersects a USGS NHDPlus HR NHDArea hydrographic polygon, such as a stream/river area, canal/ditch, inundation area, wash, levee, or other areal hydrographic landmark.
JRC Global Surface Water permanence percentage at the queried 30m cell (0 = never surface water, 100 = permanent open water).
Name of the nearest USGS NHDPlus stream / river flowline.
fields.null_meaning: Nearest NHDPlus flowline is unnamed or no flowline was found.
fields.notes: Nearest mapped flowline; not parcel inventory.

fields.definition: Name of the nearest USGS NHDPlus waterbody (lake, reservoir, pond).
fields.null_meaning: Nearest NHDPlus waterbody is unnamed or no waterbody was found.
fields.notes: Nearest mapped waterbody; not parcel inventory.

fields.definition: Depth to water at the nearest USGS NWIS groundwater well (param 72019). Sparse / often a historical reading — use as a coarse indicator.
fields.null_meaning: No NWIS groundwater well with depth data near the point, or the NWIS OGC fetch failed.

fields.definition: Station name of the nearest actively-reporting USGS discharge gage (from the monitoring-locations collection).
fields.null_meaning: No actively-reporting gage in range, the gage record carries no name, or the name lookup failed.

fields.definition: Geodesic distance to the nearest USGS gage that reported a daily-mean discharge within the last 7 days.
fields.null_meaning: No USGS gage reporting daily-mean discharge within the last 7 days inside the ~10 km search radius, or the NWIS OGC fetch failed.

fields.definition: Latest daily-mean streamflow (discharge, USGS parameter 00060) at the nearest actively-reporting USGS gage. The reading date is disclosed in the field notes; daily values lag ~1 day.
fields.null_meaning: No USGS gage reporting daily-mean discharge within the last 7 days inside the ~10 km search radius, or the NWIS OGC fetch failed.

fields.definition: True if the queried point falls inside a USFWS National Wetlands Inventory polygon (a biological wetland definition).
Geodesic meters to the nearest NWI wetland within a 500 m search; 0 if the point is on a wetland; null if none within 500 m.
fields.null_meaning: No NWI wetland polygon within the 500 m search radius.

fields.definition: Fraction (0.0-1.0) of the matched Regrid parcel's own boundary covered by USFWS NWI wetland polygons — the parcel share, computed by intersecting NWI wetlands with the parcel boundary in the parcel's local UTM (equal-area) projection. NOT the whole mapped wetland polygon's size (see the terrain-layer wetland_acres for that).
fields.null_meaning: No Regrid parcel at this coordinate.
fields.notes: Requires matched Regrid parcel at coordinate.

fields.definition: Absolute acres of USFWS NWI wetland polygon area intersecting the matched Regrid parcel's own boundary — the parcel-clipped wetland acreage, computed in the parcel's local UTM (equal-area) projection. NOT the whole mapped wetland polygon's size (see the terrain-layer wetland_acres for that).
fields.null_meaning: No Regrid parcel at this coordinate.
fields.notes: Requires matched Regrid parcel at coordinate.

fields.definition: USDA SSURGO soil drainage class at the queried point (e.g. 'Well drained', 'Poorly drained', 'Excessively drained').
USDA SSURGO hydrologic soil group of the dominant component (A/B/C/D and dual A/D, B/D, C/D; first letter = artificially-drained condition, second = natural undrained state).
fields.null_meaning: Outside the CONUS gNATSGO grid, falls back to live USDA SDA (preserves AK/HI/PR coverage); genuinely unsurveyed (ocean / no live SDA survey) → whole soil block null; or hydgrp not populated for the dominant component.

fields.definition: USDA SSURGO soil map-unit name at the queried point.
Plant-available water capacity of the dominant SSURGO component as a volume fraction (cm water per cm soil, ~0.01-0.30) between field capacity and wilting point — a ratio, not a total-water depth.
fields.null_meaning: Outside the CONUS gNATSGO grid, falls back to live USDA SDA (preserves AK/HI/PR coverage); genuinely unsurveyed (ocean / no live SDA survey) → whole soil block null; or awc_r not populated for the dominant component.

fields.definition: Worst-case ponding frequency class (None / Rare / Occasional / Frequent / Very frequent) of the dominant SSURGO component, aggregated across its 12 monthly comonth records via Soil Data Access.
fields.null_meaning: Outside the CONUS gNATSGO grid, falls back to live USDA SDA (preserves AK/HI/PR coverage); genuinely unsurveyed (ocean / no live SDA survey) → whole soil block null; or the dominant component has no ponding records for any month.

fields.definition: Representative depth (cm) to the top of the shallowest root/water-restrictive layer in the dominant SSURGO component (0-200 cm; 200 or null = no restriction found within the described 200 cm profile, right-censored — not a measured 2 m depth).
fields.null_meaning: Outside the CONUS gNATSGO grid, falls back to live USDA SDA (preserves AK/HI/PR coverage); genuinely unsurveyed (ocean / no live SDA survey) → whole soil block null; or resdept_r not populated for the dominant component.

fields.definition: Type of the shallowest root/water-restrictive layer in the dominant SSURGO component (e.g. Lithic bedrock, Paralithic bedrock, Densic material, Duripan, Fragipan).
fields.null_meaning: Outside the CONUS gNATSGO grid, falls back to live USDA SDA (preserves AK/HI/PR coverage); genuinely unsurveyed (ocean / no live SDA survey) → whole soil block null; or reskind not populated for the dominant component.

fields.definition: US Drought Monitor category at the point (D0 Abnormally Dry .. D4 Exceptional), the MAX class of the severity-nested dissolved USDM polygons containing the point. Null = point in no drought polygon (better than D0).
fields.null_meaning: Point falls in no USDM drought polygon (not in drought / better than D0); or the local read failed / the current-week snapshot is stale (>21 days old, a broken weekly refresh), in which case the null is failure-shaped.
fields.notes: USDM regional category sampled at point.

fields.definition: Mean annual dry-bulb air temperature from NOAA NCEI 1991-2020 gridded normals (~4.6 km). CONUS only.
fields.null_meaning: NCEI normals raster not bootstrapped, or outside CONUS.

fields.definition: Mean days/yr with Tmax >= 32C (90F), from NOAA NCEI nClimGrid-Daily (~5 km) averaged across years. CONUS only.
fields.null_meaning: nClimGrid-Daily raster not bootstrapped, or outside CONUS.

fields.definition: True if the queried point falls inside a FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer Special Flood Hazard Area polygon.
fields.notes: Natural flood exposure context only; not insurability.

fields.definition: FEMA NFHL flood-zone code at the queried point (e.g. AE, VE, X, A, AO), from the SFHA-driving polygon where multiple intersect.
fields.null_meaning: NFHL covers the point but no flood-zone polygon intersects, or NFHL does not cover the coordinate, or the intersecting polygon has a blank FLD_ZONE.
fields.notes: Natural flood exposure context only; not insurability.

fields.definition: Annualized wildfire event frequency (events/yr) for the containing Census tract, from FEMA National Risk Index (WFIR_AFREQ).
fields.null_meaning: Null when the point resolves to no US Census tract, the tract is absent from the local NRI table, this frequency is not tabulated for the tract, or the live tract resolve / local table read failed.
fields.notes: Census-tract NRI context; not insurability or purchase advice.
